query.text: On that day, I also took the leap to start my own movie podcast, which truly focuses on showcasing underappreciated films and directors who often do not receive the recognition they deserve. This decision has not only allowed me to dive deeper into the world of cinema but has also sparked many enlightening conversations about these hidden gems. Every episode gives me the chance to explore diverse genres and discuss intriguing narratives that may have otherwise gone unnoticed. It’s been such a fulfilling experience, as I get to engage with a community of fellow film enthusiasts who share my passion for cinematic storytelling. I'm motivated by the desire to shed light on creative voices that might be overshadowed in mainstream media.
